# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 42 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve Tells the Story of the Fall

---

**1** Eve said: 'Let me tell you what happened in paradise, so you will understand why you suffer and toil on the earth.'

**2** 'In the beginning,' she said, 'God placed your father Adam and me in paradise. We were to tend the garden and keep it.'

**3** 'God gave us every tree to eat from, except one: the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, which stood in the middle of the garden.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
